<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Implement the grammar and discovery foundation only. Start from contract tests; audit all `parseAddress` references with LSP before changing it. Structured `target: file` cells store repo-relative paths; Markdown links are discovered only inside declared `text` and keep document-relative href semantics. The shared check receives an existence seam and must not read or hash ordinary targets.
